scope: Restored the sticky transparent header by overriding the conflicting late relative-position rule.
Added a soft alternating white, mint, lilac, sand, and mist-grey section palette in light and dark themes.
Changed the homepage preview to use the connected CSS robot with neutral open lens eyes instead of the smiling cut-out background layer.
Reduced robot idle and speaking motion; chest DVNM branding glows more visibly in multicolour while speech is active.
Raised browser speech volume default from 15% to 72% and added a post-start watchdog/fallback for stalled mobile speech engines.
Adjusted floating bot and panel sizing, glass surfaces, and safe-area placement for small phones.
Bumped asset query versions and service-worker cache to v30.
image_generation: No new raster image generated; robot parts are alpha-masked derivatives of the existing supplied webp artwork and demo illustrations are hand-authored SVG.
manual_visual_test: Not completed: browser screenshot automation was blocked in this environment; verify desktop/mobile after deployment.

asset_summary.robot_art: Pure CSS renderer, no raster bot layers required for display
asset_summary.demo_detail_card_navigator: Removed from detail pages; index only
asset_summary.service_worker: v30 cache name and stylesheet/query references; release polish CSS precached

static_validation.manual_visual_test: Not completed: headless browser screenshot automation timed out in this environment. Static checks passed; verify the deployed site on desktop and small Android before considering the release fully visually tested.

robot.implementation: CSS-built connected robot using the existing DOM renderer; the homepage no longer relies on the smiling cut-out layer for the visible character.
robot.appearance: Silver/blue connected body parts, neutral illuminated lens eyes, compact rectangular mouth, and visible DVNM chest plate.
robot.idle_motion: Low-amplitude body float, subtle head movement, soft eye-lens glow, and eyelid blink.
robot.speech_animation: Mouth movement, restrained arm gestures, and a brighter multicolour DVNM chest-reactor glow are tied to browser speech state. The relationship is approximate rather than phoneme-perfect lip sync.
robot.honesty_note: The implementation is CSS/DOM artwork, not a true 3D model. Desktop/mobile visual review must still be performed after publishing.

demo_page_behavior: The seven illustrated cards appear on demos/index.html only; each detail page is a focused demonstration with one unique hero SVG.
theme_update: v30 uses a restrained pastel section rhythm (white, mint, lilac, sand, mist grey), translucent cards and a deeper transparent dark theme. Reduced-motion preferences remain respected.

bot.implementation: Unified CSS-built robot with connected joint geometry. Homepage no longer layers the smiling cut-out image over the CSS robot.
bot.appearance: Neutral open cyan lens eyes, compact straight mouth, silver/blue body, antenna and readable DVNM chest plate.
bot.speech_animation: Speaking state activates the mouth, gentle arm gestures and a brighter multicolour glow around the DVNM chest badge.
bot.voice: Browser/device Speech Synthesis, default output volume 72%, smaller text chunks, default-voice retry and stall recovery.
bot.honesty_note: Voice availability and voice quality still depend on the visitor device/browser. CSS movement approximates speech activity and is not phoneme-perfect lip sync; deployment needs live visual/device testing.
